back_translation: Audio is decoded and recoded in your browser; the original is never uploaded or modified. The output of MP3 uses a supplied local encoder. The encoding of M4A/AAC and OGG/Opus depends on the codecs available in your browser. The recoding may decrease the sound quality and the result may be larger; no copy will be offered unless it is smaller. There is no fixed upper limit on the server file size, but device memory, speed, free disk space, and browser codec support are practical limits.
